label: copy phase, near the end, input is y/r/n/e/g/j
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never in the original or delimiter phases), from recall_idx >= 2 on, and only on repeated inputs (in_first=0). It is driven by the fed-back input token: y, r, n give the strongest lift (6-8x), then e, g, j. About 80% of the mass falls on the last two outputs (to_go <= 1). It is strongest in short sequences: L=3 at t=5 has 8x lift, and the top activations are all L=3/4 sequences with y/r/e/n input at the final step. Rates are also higher when the sequence has no digits. It almost never fires on digit inputs. Precision is low: even with all conditions met, most steps stay below threshold, so the trigger is incomplete. Dev scores: F1 0.32, mass recall 0.71.
